findings.claim: The launcher census pgrep pattern is valid POSIX ERE and rejects unrelated commands, but it still misses absolute and versioned python3.N command lines that run launch.py. python3 ops/conductor/tests/test_watchdog_launcher_census.py at 85d56e22626ef0417c1eec557d7b9b613ab2ce92: 3 tests, 1 FAIL, 2 OK.

A nonterminal job with no usable worker PID is still counted running: absent, null, and keyless pid emit no unobservable line, a 13-minute missing-PID job prints a long warning, and a later live PID is never recovered from an unobservable first tick. Live, gone, settling, and closed controls stay intact. python3 ops/conductor/tests/test_watchdog_unobservable.py at 85d56e22626ef0417c1eec557d7b9b613ab2ce92: 9 tests, 5 FAIL, 4 OK.

Negative and nonfinite retained Claude usage is still measured instead of the malformed-usage gap: valid out 41 mixed with -17 becomes out=24; NaN poisons totals; a last-write that lands -17 keeps out=-17. Bool, zero, missing fields, and a valid last-write stay as controls. python3 ops/devlane/telemetry/tests/test_worth_claude_usage_currency.py at 85d56e22626ef0417c1eec557d7b9b613ab2ce92: 7 tests, 3 FAIL, 4 OK.
